instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Regression in `yarn test:app --watch=false`:
FAIL packages/excalidraw/tests/stickyNotes.test.tsx > sticky notes > editing > routes a top pick to the label and the sticky default while editing a note
AssertionError: expected '#1e1e1e' to be '#e03131' at stickyNotes.test.tsx:604 `expect(getElement(label.id).strokeColor).toBe(RED)`.
Cause: opening the editor on existing text calls `editable.select()` (textWysiwyg.tsx:1326), so the whole text is selected; actionChangeStrokeColor (around line 414) then sees a non-empty getTextEditorSelection and colours only a range instead of taking the element-wide path. Fix: in actionChangeStrokeColor, when the selection covers the whole text of the edited element (start <= 0 and end >= that element's originalText length, element found by textSelection.elementId in `elements`), do not take the range branch: fall through to the existing element-wide behaviour (including the sticky-note label/ink sync), unchanged. Partial selections keep colouring only the range. Leave the highlight action as is.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.
